test_read_excel_basic: test reading an Excel file with pd.read_excel using sheet_name and index_col parameters
test_read_excel_usecols: test pd.read_excel with usecols parameter using integer lists, string ranges, and column names
test_read_excel_multiindex: test reading Excel files with MultiIndex columns and MultiIndex rows using header and index_col parameters
test_read_excel_converters: test pd.read_excel with converters parameter to apply custom parsing functions per column
test_read_excel_dtype_backend: test pd.read_excel with dtype_backend parameter for nullable dtypes and pyarrow backend
test_read_excel_from_buffer: test reading Excel data from file-like objects and BytesIO buffers
test_read_excel_nrows_skiprows: test pd.read_excel with nrows and skiprows parameters including callable skiprows
test_excel_file_context_manager: test pd.ExcelFile as a context manager for reading multiple sheets from an Excel workbook
test_excel_engine_selection: test automatic and explicit engine selection across xls, xlsx, xlsm, xlsb, and ods formats
test_excel_error_handling: test pd.read_excel error handling for bad engines, corrupt files, and invalid sheet names
